This is a beta of NebulaCoop 2.0: online co-op for Super Mario Galaxy, built on [keepvaibin's Nebula](https://github.com/keepvaibin/nebula) v2.0.0-beta.1, which runs the game as native code built from SMGCommunity's Petari decompilation. It comes for Windows, Linux, macOS and Android. You need your own copy of the game. A beta is for trying the game and telling us what breaks: expect faults, and keep a copy of your saves.

## Downloads

| System | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 or 11 (x64) | [Nebula-Beta-Setup.exe](https://github.com/NebulaCoop/nebula-coop/releases/download/v2.0.0-beta.1/Nebula-Beta-Setup.exe) |
| Linux (x86-64) | [Nebula-Beta-Linux-x64.tar.gz](https://github.com/NebulaCoop/nebula-coop/releases/download/v2.0.0-beta.1/Nebula-Beta-Linux-x64.tar.gz) |
| macOS 12 or later (Intel and Apple silicon) | [Nebula-Beta-macOS.zip](https://github.com/NebulaCoop/nebula-coop/releases/download/v2.0.0-beta.1/Nebula-Beta-macOS.zip) |
| Android 12 or later (64-bit ARM) | [Nebula-Beta-Android.apk](https://github.com/NebulaCoop/nebula-coop/releases/download/v2.0.0-beta.1/Nebula-Beta-Android.apk) |

`SHA256SUMS` lists the SHA-256 of each download. The `.sig` and `.manifest` files are what NebulaCoop's updates check before they install a new version. A beta is offered the next beta and the final 2.0.0; NebulaCoop 1.0.x is not offered the beta.

## Install

**Windows:** run `Nebula-Beta-Setup.exe`. It isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen shows "Unknown publisher": choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. Setup installs NebulaCoop beside Nebula, never over it. If you have Nebula installed, Setup offers to import its game files, saves and settings (Nebula itself is left as it is). Otherwise choose your own copy of the game.

**Linux:** unpack `Nebula-Beta-Linux-x64.tar.gz` (in a file manager: Extract Here; in a terminal: `tar -xzf Nebula-Beta-Linux-x64.tar.gz`), open the folder that appears in a terminal and run `./install.sh` (or `sh install.sh`). When it asks, choose your Super Mario Galaxy disc image, then install for your account or as a portable folder. Preparing the game takes a few minutes.

**macOS:** unzip the download and move `Nebula.app` to Applications. It runs on Intel Macs and on Apple silicon. It is not signed by Apple: the first time, open it from **System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway**. The included `How to open Nebula.txt` has the steps.

**Android:** install `Nebula-Beta-Android.apk`, open it, and choose your disc image.

The game is read from Super Mario Galaxy for Wii from North America (RMGE01), Europe (RMGP01) or Japan (RMGJ01), as an ISO, RVZ or extracted folder.

## What is in

- Everything in Nebula v2.0.0-beta.1: native code on Windows (Direct3D 12, Direct3D 11 or Vulkan), Linux and Android (Vulkan) and macOS (Metal), the new home screen, upscaling and graphics options, controllers with gyro pointing, save and Mii import, achievements, and Nebula's menus in 14 languages.
- Online co-op: host a room or join one through NebulaNet (a password or a room code) or a direct address, see the other players in every galaxy, play through the host's save together (switches, bosses and the Comet Observatory's star bit bank are shared), and chat with commands.
- Mods: unlike Nebula's beta, NebulaCoop keeps mod support. Personal Star Counter and Character Movesets come built in, and `.lumacoop` co-op mods work.

## Known issues

- On Linux, macOS and Android, this beta installs where Nebula does (the same install folder, app and app id): don't install it on a system that has Nebula. Windows installs beside Nebula.
- Co-op on Linux, macOS and Android has had little play so far. Tell us what breaks.

## Report a fault

Report problems on the [issue tracker](https://github.com/NebulaCoop/nebula-coop/issues). Say which system, which graphics card or device and which driver or system version you have, what you were doing, whether you were in a room (and how many players), and attach the log of the run:

- **Windows:** `%LOCALAPPDATA%\NebulaCoop\logs\latest.log`. When the game stops, it shows an error code and saves a report in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\NebulaCoop\crashes`: attach both files of it (the `.txt` and the `.dmp`).
- **Linux:** `~/.local/share/NebulaCoop/logs/game.log` (`game.previous.log` is the run before).
- **macOS:** `~/Library/Application Support/NebulaCoop/logs/game.log` (and `game.previous.log`).
- **Android:** choose **Share the game's log** in the settings and attach it.

## Requirements

- **Windows:** Windows 10 (1803 or later) or Windows 11, 64-bit, with a GPU that supports Direct3D 11 or later.
- **Linux:** x86-64 with glibc 2.39 and libstdc++ 3.4.32 (GCC 13) or later (for example Ubuntu 24.04 or Fedora 40), and the Vulkan loader (`libvulkan1`) with a driver.
- **macOS:** macOS 12 or later, on an Intel or Apple silicon Mac.
- **Android:** Android 12 or later, 64-bit ARM, Vulkan 1.1.
